purpose: Learner-facing Family source copy in every canonical learn-from language. These localizations are the reusable Core-mode doorway for the four-stage Family path; richer stage-specific cultural analysis is a separate capability and must never be inferred from localization coverage alone.

session_depth_policy.core_when: either active language role is outside full_target_languages
session_depth_policy.cultural_when: both active language roles are in full_target_languages and the requested stage has the required cultural assets
session_depth_policy.important: A rich localization for one language does not unlock Cultural mode by itself. Depth is resolved from the pair.

extended_v1.description: Rich reusable Family copy. In a Core session the runtime still renders only the Core block subset; extended copy is not permission to bypass pair-level depth.

compact_core_v1.description: Compact source localization for Core Family sessions. The already-localized source bridge supplies the generic family introduction; stage-specific Core screens may reuse it until a dedicated stage localization is reviewed.

review_policy: Machine-created localization can provide coverage but must stay labeled machine_translated until native/community review promotes it. Language availability, vocabulary breadth, cultural depth, and human verification are separate states.
